gloss: to raise prices; to mark up

definitions.gloss: to raise prices; to mark up
definitions.explanation: To increase the price or cost of goods or services.

examples.japanese: ⟦{電気代|でんきだい}→電気代：09543_denkidai⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{値上|ねあ}げされた。
⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{店|みせ}→店：00497_mise⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{毎年|まいとし}→毎年：00731_maitoshi⟧{値上|ねあ}げして⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧。
examples.english: This store raises prices every year.

examples.japanese: ⟦{原材料|げんざいりょう}→原材料：18966_genzairyou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{高騰|こうとう}→高騰：14647_koutou⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦より→より：09476_yori⟧、⟦{商品|しょうひん}→商品：01436_shouhin⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{値上|ねあ}げせざる⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{得|え}なかった→得る：02014_eru⟧。
examples.english: Due to soaring raw material costs, they had no choice but to raise prices on their products.

notes:
Refers specifically to raising prices, as opposed to prices rising on their own. The noun form ⟦{値上|ねあ}げ→値上げ：07582_neage⟧ is commonly used on its own to mean 'a price increase.'

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{家賃|やちん}→家賃：03639_yachin⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{値上|ねあ}げする: to raise the rent
- ⟦{料金|りょうきん}→料金：03797_ryoukin⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{値上|ねあ}げする: to raise fees
- ⟦{大幅|おおはば}→大幅：12170_oohaba⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{値上|ねあ}げする: to raise prices significantly
- ⟦{一斉|いっせい}→一斉：01726_issei⟧⟦{値上|ねあ}げ→値上げ：07582_neage⟧: across-the-board price increase

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{値下|ねさ}げ→値下げ：07583_nesage⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to lower prices — the opposite action
- ⟦{値上|ねあ}がり→値上がり：11538_neagari⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to go up in price — describes prices rising by themselves, without specifying who raised them
- ⟦{高|たか}く→高い：00500_takai⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧: to become expensive — a more general and casual expression
